description: This file is a shell script that contains tests for a git feature related to internationalization (i18n), encoding handling, and log search capabilities, including creating commits with different encodings and verifying log output based on encoding and grep pattern types.

methods.name: triggers_undefined_behaviour
methods.description: Determines if a given engine triggers undefined behaviour based on prerequisites and locale capabilities.

parameters.name: engine
parameters.description: The regex engine type being tested.

methods.name: mismatched_git_log
methods.description: Runs a git log command with specified encoding and pattern, returning its output.

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.description: The search pattern to grep within logs.
